name: Build Royal Nard Android APK (10.9 THEMES)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'RoyalNard_v10_9_THEMES.zip'
      - '.github/workflows/build-from-archive.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Extract the correct 10.9 THEMES source archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ARCHIVE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/RoyalNard_v10_9_THEMES.zip"
          SRC="$RUNNER_TEMP/royalnard-10.9-themes"
          test -f "$ARCHIVE" || { echo 'ERROR: RoyalNard_v10_9_THEMES.zip not found in repository root'; exit 1; }
          mkdir -p "$SRC"
          unzip -q "$ARCHIVE" -d "$SRC"
          test -f "$SRC/settings.gradle"
          test -f "$SRC/app/build.gradle"
          test -f "$SRC/app/src/main/assets/index.html"
          grep -q 'data-theme="emerald"' "$SRC/app/src/main/assets/index.html"
          grep -q 'data-theme="silver"' "$SRC/app/src/main/assets/index.html"
          grep -q 'data-theme="turquoise"' "$SRC/app/src/main/assets/index.html"
          grep -q 'data-theme="burgundy"' "$SRC/app/src/main/assets/index.html"
          # The archive carries 10.8 Gradle metadata; align the installed app with this 10.9 theme build.
          sed -i "s/versionCode 108/versionCode 109/; s/versionName '10.8'/versionName '10.9'/" "$SRC/app/build.gradle"
          grep -q "versionCode 109" "$SRC/app/build.gradle"
          grep -q "versionName '10.9'" "$SRC/app/build.gradle"
          cp -a "$SRC/." "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/"
          echo 'Verified: build source is RoyalNard_v10_9_THEMES.zip and contains the theme selector.'

      - name: Run game rules smoke tests
        run: node tools/smoke-test.js

      - name: Set up Java 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Set up Android SDK
        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v4

      - name: Accept Android SDK licenses
        run: yes | sdkmanager --licenses

      - name: Install Android platform and build tools
        run: sdkmanager 'platform-tools' 'platforms;android-35' 'build-tools;35.0.0'

      - name: Set up Gradle 8.9
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.9'

      - name: Build Royal Nard 10.9 THEMES APK
        run: gradle --no-daemon clean assembleDebug

      - name: Upload 10.9 THEMES APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Royal-Nard-10.9-THEMES-Android-APK
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
